title: Customer Care Credit Schedule: Overcharge-Age Credit — Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
**Rule.** The overcharge-age credit of a correction of a charged Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee is read from the calendar days from the charge date to the day of the correction: more than the long-age days take the long-age credit; from the short-age days up to the long-age days take the short-age credit; fewer days take no overcharge-age credit.

| Calendar days from the charge date to the day of the correction | Overcharge-age credit |
|---|---|
| more than 45 (long age) | 8% |
| 15 to 45 (short age) | 4% |
| fewer than 15 | none |

The charge date is the one on the assessment. The overcharge-age credit is a percentage reduction of the fee as it then stands, applied immediately before the final rounding; the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Boundary days (hypothetical; charge dated 1 March)

| Day of the correction | Days | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 14 | none |
| 16 March | 15 | 4% |
| 15 April | 45 | 4% |
| 16 April | 46 | 8% |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A fee of $95.00 standing before the credit, with a 4% overcharge-age credit: $95.00 reduced by 4%, that is $91.20.
